1.consolidated_definition: Bejuco leñoso, trepador, de hasta 10 m de altura, con espinas, hojas alternas ovadas, flores en grandes grupos terminales de color blanco, y fruto capsular; se utiliza en la medicina tradicional. Nyctaginaceae, Bougainvillea spp.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Woody vine, climbing, up to 10 m in height, with thorns, alternate ovate leaves, flowers in large terminal groups of white color, and capsular fruit; used in traditional medicine. Nyctaginaceae, Bougainvillea spp.
